title: Bungo Stray Dogs
native_title: 文豪ストレイドッグス
source: Bungo Stray Dogs manga by Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: In a stylised Yokohama, people with supernatural Abilities named after famous literary works work for rival organisations. The Armed Detective Agency handles dangerous cases between day and night, while the Port Mafia rules the underworld. Former mafia executive Osamu Dazai now works for the Agency and mentors Atsushi Nakajima. Clashes with the Guild, the Rats in the House of the Dead and the Decay of Angels threaten the city. Stylish, witty and dramatic.
power_system: Ability users each have one Ability named after a literary work. Dazai's 'No Longer Human' cancels any Ability he touches. Atsushi turns into a white tiger ('Beast Beneath the Moonlight'); Chuuya controls gravity ('For the Tainted Sorrow').
